svg.title: Proof and time record. The no-jump propagator solves ̇K0(t) = −(κ/2)ΠK0(t). A jump at t has operator density Lt = √κe−κt/2|f⟩⟨r|. Integrating LtρL† t dt over [0, T] yields the click branch; an absorbing flag prevents a second click. Completeness follows by integration or Eq. (1). Tensoring Kraus operators with IR proves the reference formula. Retaining exact click time keeps LtρL† t dt as a separate classical record. Time bins integrate over each declared bin and retain its label. Coarsening that record is an explicit forgetting operation. □
